tool_args.rationale: All pilot horizons are at most 0.48, but the forecast horizon is 23.2. Positive short-window gain does not establish whether slow adaptation will dominate later. The slow-horizon probe directly tests that uncertainty before fitting the sink-coupled model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled adaptation model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows can constrain the initial adaptation slope but do not reliably separate its amplitude from its time constant.
Finer sampling is less useful than extending the observation horizon to resolve the slow response.
